recipes.title: Chicken tinga tacos
steps: Simmer the chicken in salted water until tender, about 25 minutes. Shred.
Soften the onion in oil, add garlic for a minute.
Blend tomatoes, chipotles and oregano; pour into the pan and simmer 5 minutes.
Fold in the chicken and cook until saucy.
Serve on warm tortillas with cotija and cilantro.
recipes.about: Smoky, a little sweet, and better the next day.

recipes.title: Sheet-pan lemon salmon
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the beans with oil, salt and pepper on a sheet pan.
Lay the salmon on top with lemon slices.
Roast 12–15 minutes.
Finish with dill.
recipes.about: A weeknight dinner that cleans up in one pan.

recipes.title: Slow-cooker beef chili
steps: Brown the beef with the onion.
Move everything to the slow cooker.
Cook on low 6 hours.
Taste and adjust the salt.
recipes.about: Made for game days and cold nights.

recipes.title: Rice pilaf
steps: Brown the vermicelli in butter.
Stir in the rice for a minute.
Add broth and salt, bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer 18 minutes, then rest 5.
recipes.about: The side that goes with everything.

recipes.title: Cornbread
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F with a buttered skillet inside.
Mix dry, then wet, then together.
Pour into the hot skillet.
Bake 20 minutes.
recipes.about: Crisp edges from the hot skillet.

recipes.title: Mango rice pudding
steps: Simmer rice, milk, sugar and cinnamon, stirring, 30 minutes.
Cool slightly.
Top with mango.
recipes.about: Warm or cold, kids love it.
